raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Usage reporting counts the image, audio and video prompt tokens of a request by scanning every item in `req.multimodal_inputs`. The output streamer does this for each output row, and the PD metadata buffer does it once more on the prefill node. A streaming session shares its media history across turns, so a session that appends one audio chunk per turn rescans the whole accumulated history on every turn: the cost of reporting usage grows linearly with the number of turns instead of with the media actually added.

A second, smaller problem sits in the same code: disaggregated decode treated an all-zero transferred count as "not computed" and fell back to recounting locally, so the prefill-side result was authoritative only when it was non-zero.

## Modifications

- `Req` gains `get_mm_token_counts()`, which computes the per-modality counts at most once and caches them with an explicit `mm_token_counts_ready` flag, and `inherit_mm_token_counts(other)`, which copies the counts of a request whose media history is shared.
- `Session.create_req` inherits the counts from the previous turn when the new turn is a plain continuation. It does not inherit on abort or when a `session_params.offset` truncates the inherited history, so those cases fall back to a full count.
- `Req.extend_image_inputs` adds only the counts of the newly appended items when the counts are already cached.
- The output streamer and `MetadataBuffers.set_buf` both read through the accessor. `DecodeTransferQueue` marks the counts received from prefill as ready, so a transferred zero is final.

Behaviour of a single-turn request is unchanged; the change is that repeated reads are served from the cache.

Tests: a new `test_mm_token_counts.py` covers memoisation of all-zero counts and inherit-then-extend across a session turn; `test_session_token_share_unit.py` gains a case where an aborted turn's edits to the counts do not leak into the next turn. The existing `_FakeReq` fixtures in the output-streamer tests and the PD wire test gain the accessor. The three new cases fail on `main` and pass with this change.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: usage token counts are bookkeeping and do not affect generation.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable beyond the mechanism described above: with a cached count, appending one item to a history of N items costs one item scan instead of N+1.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+import unittest
+from array import array
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import (
+    Modality,
+    MultimodalDataItem,
+    MultimodalInputs,
+    Req,
+)
+from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _item(modality, *offsets):
+    return MultimodalDataItem(modality=modality, offsets=list(offsets) or None)
+
+
+def _req(rid):
+    return Req(rid, "", array("q"), SamplingParams(max_new_tokens=1))
+
+
+class TestMultimodalTokenCounts(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_request_memoizes_empty_counts(self):
+        """All-zero counts must be cached too; a zero result is not a cache miss."""
+        req = _req("empty")
+        req.multimodal_inputs = mm = MagicMock()
+        mm.compute_mm_token_counts.return_value = (0, 0, 0)
+
+        self.assertEqual(req.get_mm_token_counts(), (0, 0, 0))
+        self.assertEqual(req.get_mm_token_counts(), (0, 0, 0))
+        mm.compute_mm_token_counts.assert_called_once_with()
+
+    def test_session_request_inherits_and_extends_counts(self):
+        """A session turn reuses the prior turn's counts and adds only new media."""
+        parent = _req("parent")
+        audio = _item(Modality.AUDIO, (0, 3))
+        parent.multimodal_inputs = history = MultimodalInputs(mm_items=[audio])
+
+        child = _req("child")
+        child.session = object()
+        child.origin_input_ids = array("q", range(8))
+        child.multimodal_inputs = history
+        child.inherit_mm_token_counts(parent)
+        child.extend_image_inputs(
+            MultimodalInputs(mm_items=[_item(Modality.IMAGE, (4, 7))])
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(parent.get_mm_token_counts(), (0, 4, 0))
+        self.assertEqual(child.get_mm_token_counts(), (4, 4, 0))
+        self.assertIsNot(child.multimodal_inputs, history)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -91,6 +91,9 @@ def __init__(
     def finished(self):
         return self._finished
 
+    def get_mm_token_counts(self):
+        return self.mm_image_tokens, self.mm_audio_tokens, self.mm_video_tokens
+
     def init_incremental_detokenize(self):
         return self.output_ids_through_stop, 0

@@ -59,6 +59,9 @@ def __init__(self, *, is_retracted: bool, max_new_tokens: int):

     def init_incremental_detokenize(self):

@@ -105,6 +105,21 @@ def test_normal_multi_turn_share_and_carry(self):
         self.assertEqual(list(r3.origin_input_ids), in1 + out1 + in2 + out2 + [9])
         self.assertEqual(list(r3.full_untruncated_fill_ids), list(r3.origin_input_ids))
 
+    def test_multimodal_counts_follow_committed_history(self):
+        """An aborted turn's count edits must not leak into the next turn."""
+        r1 = self._create("r1", [1])
+        r1.mm_image_tokens, r1.mm_audio_tokens, r1.mm_video_tokens = (2, 3, 4)
+        r1.mm_token_counts_ready = True
+        self._decode_and_finish(r1, [])
+
+        r2 = self._create("r2", [2])
+        self.assertEqual(r2.get_mm_token_counts(), (2, 3, 4))
+        r2.mm_image_tokens = 5
+        self.session.abort_req()
+
+        r3 = self._create("r3", [3])
+        self.assertEqual(r3.get_mm_token_counts(), (2, 3, 4))
+
     def test_mid_turn_abort_then_continue(self):
         in1, out1 = list(range(200, 210)), [1, 2, 3]
         r1 = self._create("r1", in1)
